en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large military parade marching along a broad Parisian boulevard lined with Haussmann‑style buildings. Soldiers in World War I uniforms carry rifles and flags. In the center background is a large sculpted lion on a decorated plinth, surrounded by flags and crowds. Spectators watch from the sidewalks and from balconies. Red printed caption text appears at the top of the card.
